question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word ‘liberate’ from the following sentence.

There is a famous saying by Rousseau which says that man is born free but he is surrounded by the clutches of slavery in society.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Free'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Liberate'** refers to setting someone free from a situation, especially imprisonment or slavery, in which their liberty is severely restricted. **('मुक्त करना').**

 
 
• **Example: **The prisoners were liberated by the soldiers. 
 
 
 
• **'Free' **refers to not being under the control or in the power of another; having liberty. **('स्वतंत्र' or 'मुक्त')**.
 
 
• **Example:** The slaves were finally made free. 
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **'option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Surrounded'** refers to being all around something or someone. **('घेरा होना').**
 
• **'Slavery'** refers to a condition of being owned by and forced to work for someone else.** ('दासता' or 'ग़ुलामी').**
 
• **'Clutches' **refers to a tight grip or hold. **('जकड़')**.

3a:T541,
